# Change-points

## Identify change-points

```{r}
### cpt analysis
results_cpt <- changepoint_analysis(Herring_full, 
                                          region_name = "Full Stock",
                                          year_col = "year",
                                          Q = 6,
                                          bcp_threshold = 0.5,
                                          ssb_col = "SSB")
# CPT changepoint indices:  4,    16,   18,   34,   37,   51 
# CPT changepoint years:    1950, 1964, 1966, 1986, 2000, 2018 

## BCP Analysis
# BCP changepoint indices:  20,   37,   54 
# BCP changepoint years:    1966, 1983, 2000 

## Consensus Analysis
# Consensus changepoints (± 1 yr, min 5 yr apart): 1966, 2000 
# CPT only: 1950, 1964, 1986, 2018 
# BCP only: 1983  
```

## Plot Change-points

```{r}
### Call function plot_SSB_cpt
plot_SSB_cpt_full <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = Herring_full,
              changepoints = c(1966, 1986,2000), 
              ribbon_colors = c("steelblue", "orange", "grey", "purple"),
              vline_colors = c("black", "grey", "black"),
              component = "Full Stock", 
              SSB_column = "SSB", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd", 
              show_hlines = TRUE)
plot_SSB_cpt_full
```

### Save plots

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SSB_cpt_full.png"),
       plot = plot_SSB_cpt_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# Hysteresis

## Analysis

```{r}
### Check for time-lags
ccf(Herring_full$SSB[-(79:78)], Herring_full$F[-(79:78)], type = "correlation") # 3 years lag
Herring_full$SSB_lag <- lag(Herring_full$SSB, 3)

### Call "breakpoint_analysis" function
results_brkpt <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring_full, "SSB", "F", "year",
                                    lag_years = 3, 
                                    region_name = "Full Stock")

# Optimal number of breaks: 4 
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.25  1.43  0.43  0.22 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1960, 1971, 1986, 2000 
```

## Plotting

```{r}
### Call function plot_hysteresis
plot_hysteresis_full <- plot_hysteresis(Herring_full, results_brkpt$break_years, "Full Stock")
plot_hysteresis_full
```

### save plot

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "hysteresis_full.png"),
       plot = plot_hysteresis_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# SRR Non-Stationary

## Analysis

```{r}
### Run model comparison from model_comp_functions.R 
source("R/model_comp_functions.R")

models_SRR <- run_srr_analysis(
  data_for_srr = Herring_full,
  recruit_col = "Recruitment", 
  ssb_col = "SSB",
  max_breaks = 4,
  use_bic = TRUE)

models_SRR[["comparison_table"]]

#### Bad overdispertion for GLM's exept nebinom
#### While seg.log shows best r_sqrt it has horible RSME
#### strucchange model shows lowest RMSE, with second best R_sqrt

### Prep data for LOOCV function
dat <- Herring_full %>%
  mutate(R_log = log(Recruitment),
         SSB_log = log(SSB)) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, Recruitment, SSB, R_log, SSB_log) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  setNames(c("Year", "R", "SSB", "R_log", "SSB_log")) %>%
  as.data.frame()

### Call function "cross_valid" for performing loocv for all models
rmse_mean_herring <- cross_valid(dataset = dat)
#         linear    beverton    ricker      segmented   seg.log     segm.glm    strucchange
# TEST:   10164856  9080981     10040655    9437569     9475234     9394538     12472272
# TRAIN:  12568771  12158586    12366932    11012203    11184582    11014417    8777879

#### strucchange shows bad prediction performance for but great fit to historical data, segmented models show best balance.
#### Classical non segmented models show general bad performance (except beverton-holts good prediction performance).

### Call function "srr_breakpoint_analysis"
results_SRR <- srr_breakpoint_analysis(Herring_full, "SSB", "Recruitment", "year", "Herring Full", method ="segmented")

# Running segmented model analysis
# Using mean SSB as initial psi: 1647949 
# Segmented model breakpoint:
# SSB breakpoint: 553296.5 ± 108381.8 
# Approximate year: 1983 
```

## Plotting

```{r}
plot_SRR_full <- plot_SRR(Herring_full, break_years = results_SRR$breakpoint_year, "Full Stock", "segmented")
plot_SRR_full
```

#### save plot

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SRR_full.png"),
       plot = plot_SRR_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```
